name: SOLUTN
recent: Solution Group Berhad 近期出现股权变动，Datuk Lim Nyuk Sang 出售 2400 万股后不再是主要股东，Calvin Lau Chuen Yien 及 Lavin Group Sdn. Bhd. 成为新主要股东。公司委任前 Gas Malaysia 高管 Ahmad Hashimi 进入董事会，并有一项重大诉讼公告。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长 26.1%，但录得净亏损。
notable: Datuk Lim Nyuk Sang 出售 2400 万股后不再是公司主要股东。
Calvin Lau Chuen Yien 及 Lavin Group Sdn. Bhd. 成为公司新主要股东。
公司委任前 Gas Malaysia 高管 Ahmad Hashimi 进入董事会。
risks: 公司有一项重大诉讼公告。
最新季度录得净亏损 MYR 128,000。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 10,961,000，环比增长 26.1%，同比增长 99.6%；净亏损为 MYR 128,000，净利率 -1.2%，上一季度净利率为 2.9%。

recent_en: Solution Group Berhad saw recent shareholding changes: Datuk Lim Nyuk Sang ceased to be a substantial shareholder after selling 24 million shares, while Calvin Lau Chuen Yien and Lavin Group Sdn. Bhd. became new substantial shareholders. The company appointed former Gas Malaysia chief Ahmad Hashimi to the board and announced a material litigation. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 26.1% QoQ but recorded a net loss.
notable_en: Datuk Lim Nyuk Sang ceased to be a substantial shareholder after selling 24 million shares.
Calvin Lau Chuen Yien and Lavin Group Sdn. Bhd. became new substantial shareholders.
The company appointed former Gas Malaysia chief Ahmad Hashimi to the board.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 128,000.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 10,961,000, up 26.1% QoQ and 99.6% YoY; net loss was MYR 128,000 with a net margin of -1.2%, compared with a net margin of 2.9% in the previous quarter.
